These sources establish parcel geometry access, not title or complete city coverage.
dataFindings.reason: 180 valid, distinct DGC INSPIRE cadastral parcel references verified in thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged ranked Valencia WUP locator. Actual GML members matched both numberMatched and numberReturned in all cells; a maxFeatures=3 cap rejected a 38-feature reply. This WFS does not implement offset paging; no offset-paging success is claimed. All 180 fresh exact-reference geometry reads matched, explicit provider absence messages matched both the requested REFCAT and UTM zone, and footprint/source-binding checks passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:25830 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Only three safe sample geometries are retained in the repository. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and parcel coverage exactly at the WUP point remain unverified.

The official DFFE-hosted service advertises GeoJSON but rejects that format in actual queries; explicit native Esri JSON queries succeed. A strict reader preserves every straight-ring coordinate and assigns native holes/components without repair; native curve representations and unsupported or ambiguous rings remain unavailable. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging (42 rows over fourteen pages), all 201 fresh native PRCL_KEY reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32735 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The sampled records all have publisher statuses R/C/E; no guessed lifecycle filter is applied. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and broader identity uniqueness remain unverified.

The service-advertised GEOJSON response preserves native EPSG:25832 boundaries, transformed with an explicit ETRS89 projection. FSK is native cadastral identity; OBJECTID/GmlID remain transport identity. Stable hit counts before and after all pages, strict default OBJECTID order, forced three-row pagination, all 191 fresh native FSK reads through FES equality, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Unsupported application/json and sorting requests, and the different POST serializer, remain documented; the executable profile uses only supported GET operations. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.

dataFindings.registryBasis: The City of St. Petersburg, Florida, hosts an official municipal parcel polygon service, while Pinellas County Property Appraiser publishes county parcel polygons and explicitly covers St. Petersburg in its jurisdiction mapping guidance. The city service returned no feature at that locator, so the retained sample indicates county parcel coverage near the ranked settlement point, not verified municipal-boundary coverage. This packet is for Florida, not Saint Petersburg, Russia.
dataFindings.reason: 38 valid distinct Pinellas County land polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Saint Petersburg metropolitan WUP locator in Florida. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row batches, all 38 fresh native PARCELID reads, valid absence, footprint and binding passed. Publisher-coded PARCELSUBTYPE=0 is Land Polygon; unit/subsurface/discrepancy classes are outside this explicit ground scope, which is enforced on every returned feature. Qualified joined column names are retained exactly. Native EPSG:3857 GeoJSON is requested with the documented geometryPrecision=6 parameter (one micrometre in response metres), retained without local rounding, and transformed explicitly only after CRS/precision verification. Earlier unfiltered/float-serialization failures remain preserved. Independent EPSG:32617 GEOS found no invalid/duplicate geometries and two narrow overlaps totalling 0.27016 m². Original unrounded native responses reproduce both as boundary slivers about 3.5 millimetres wide; they remain unchanged and are accepted for bounded reference use. The county feed covers nearby metropolitan ground, including the exact WUP point, without establishing Saint Petersburg municipal-only or citywide coverage, legal title, survey accuracy or long-term key continuity.

A fresh original native EPSG:4148 response reproduces that overlap as a strip under one millimetre wide over about 54 metres; both full polygons retain it without repair or exclusion and are accepted for bounded reference use. The publisher states its web dataset is beta/not current and coordinates are not legal values; currentness, legal title, survey accuracy and wider citywide completeness remain unverified.

This is bounded metropolitan reference geometry, without claims of George Town municipal-only or citywide completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy or long-term key continuity.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry’s official INSPIRE Index Polygons download supplies a Portsmouth City Council local-authority ZIP. The GML contains 65,055 features; at the unchanged WUP point one full source polygon (INSPIREID 30222163) covers the point. The layer represents indicative extents/positions of registered freehold properties, not a complete legal cadastre. In a bounded 400 m × 400 m EPSG:27700 window, 112 complete geometries were valid and 29 pairs had positive-area overlaps above 0.01 m² (largest 194.723 m²); the WUP-covering feature itself overlaps another index polygon by 0.469 m². This is positive source geometry with a native-topology runtime hold, not evidence of no coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Full HMLR INSPIRE index polygon verified at exact WUP point. Scope is registered freehold extent/location only; local 400 m geometry QA shows native overlaps, and no citywide completeness is claimed.

integrationPolicy.description: User-selected passthrough sources: terms and licences are recorded as notices and never block technical integration.
integrationPolicy.runtimeStorage: No new parcel database imports; live proxy reads and browser session memory.
technicalRequirements: stable application identity: publisher-native parcel identity where available, or deterministic source-scoped, versioned geometry identity for geometry-only application references
complete bounded paging and fresh exact-ID or exact-geometry reads

identityPolicy.geometryDerivedIdentityMethod: Source namespace plus canonical geometry SHA-256 with an explicit version marker and documented precision/canonicalization; exact reads must verify the full current geometry hash.
identityPolicy.geometryDerivedIdentityLimits: A geometry-derived reference identifies an observed geometry version only. It is not a source registry number, cannot join to legal records or ownership data, and a changed boundary creates a new reference.

US.stateCoverageMeaning: Counts configured city providers within states, never whole-state completeness.

centralAsia.scope: Five capitals of the Central Asian republics; all five city outcomes integrated after North acceptance.
centralAsia.pointBasisNote: Dushanbe, Astana, Bishkek and Ashgabat use chosen central-city query points, not WUP centroids or official boundaries.

africa.scope: 54 African UN member states with separate political, administrative, legislative, royal and associated former/transitional seats; separately labelled Western Sahara/SADR and Somaliland supplement. Overseas territorial and provincial capitals excluded.

world.scope: 193 UN member states and the two UN observer states, separate established or transitional government seats, and clearly labelled associated/disputed/de facto supplementary seats. Overseas dependencies and ordinary subnational capitals excluded.

growthResearch.note: Registry or local cadastral-map evidence is distinct from public polygon access and live runtime integration.
